entry_points.text: Control dispatches add delete list trim equiv signal and terminal with locked refusal and config logging; rule change accepts add or delete translating then installing or freeing with logging.
Equivalence resolves locations walks trees with barrier holding refs across unlock checks containment tags inodes then clears on success or trims on failure; trim prunes stale attachments.
Pipeline builds entry with class expansion converts fields validates combos and searches duplicates; unpacking validates bounds copies bytes terminates and advances.

Netlink input dispatches each message under lock then applies backlog backpressure; bring-up inits caches queues and hashes registers handling starts daemon and applies boot defaults with diagnostics.

exports.text: Tree watch and mark helpers share one name in two forms: full logic when enabled and inert fallbacks otherwise, with empty path strings and trap or no-op removal.
Creation validates absolute paths, resolves identity outside the mutex, shares existing parents or trees on match, otherwise publishes new objects with device inode identity and mount coverage.
Rules compare by header and masks, delete the match with counter updates and deferred free, enumerate via snapshot plus thread, and detach attachments with prune queuing and parent cleanup.
Logging records removal keys config changes multicast denied paths labels and packets, suppressed when disabled or without buffers, otherwise with identity terminal session and result.

hazards.text: Blocking risks retirement mitigated by refs and goner checks; untag races by mark refs; prune starts once; invalid policy warns; session retry single; failures unwind with silent skips.
Control covers add delete list trim equiv signal terminal and config change; failure covers invalid permission memory too-long nospace locked terminal notify hash alloc and path bound.
LSM subject and object selectors plus filter list action operator permission type family and dimension symbols define vocabulary without numeric encodings.
External list RCU mutex spin barrier refcount error credential dcache fsnotify kthread netlink sched security string and numeric helpers are owned elsewhere and not specified here.

invariants.text: Locked enable refuses mutation yet logs it; terminal holds two bits queried atomically set only to zero or one; login reassignment needs privilege unless unset skipping reserved value.
Extraction validates bounds and terminates; packing advances cursor; rule build expands classes converts fields validates combos maps operators by search and enforces caps with login normalization.
Duplicates search by attachment scope with inode buckets; exit rules get monotonic priority with prepend choosing head; signal coverage selects masks by arch and requires intersection.
Hash scales key by cache width modulo size with barrier; top owner bit tags transient state; refcounts with RCU retire objects; detach clears backpointers and queues prune.
Wire translation preserves flags list action field count and masks, encodes operators, packs labels paths keys and marks with length accumulation and normalizes legacy unset login form.

locks.text: Filter mutex serializes traversal duplicate search insertion and linkage, released across blocking lookups with reference held and liveness revalidated.
Hash spin protects membership owners roots linkage goner and mark association; group lock orders before it; readers use RCU with barrier publish grace wait and deferred free.

state_machines.text: Trees go active to goner then detach rules prune and drop refs; chunks free via RCU; tagging clears on success trims on failure; rules install or free.
Subtree goes seed to shared or published then tagging and activation committing if membership survives; watch goes temp to parent discovery with sharing transfer then linking.
Each net namespace owns one endpoint created at init and released at exit; bind needs read capability and logs outcome while unbind logs disconnect.

structs.text: Trees carry refcount lists pathname root and goner; chunks carry hash linkage key mark and owner array; watches and marks carry pathname device inode identity and membership.
Rules aggregate list action flags priority field count masks tagged fields arch inode refs key exe watch subtree pointers length accounting and linkage.
